items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Butterbeens and Susie was big. Male and female. Male and male.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know what you're talking about. Like Butterbeens and Susie? You never saw them, huh? Grant and Wilson. A lot of funny calls. Yeah.
Butterbeens and Susie was big. Male and female. Male and male.
Mostly a man and his wife. Yeah. William Walker. Yeah. William Walker. Yeah, William Walker. Did you see Burt Williams ever? That's a man I did when they did. Yeah. He probably didn't get back to.
